title: Using Sociolinguistic Variables to Reveal Changing Attitudes Towards Sexuality and Gender
reasoning: The paper analyzes sociolinguistic variation across different demographic groups, including religious communities identified via subreddits (e.g., r/Christianity, r/Islam). While it uses religious affiliation as a variable to study linguistic shifts in society, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics themselves, nor does it examine these topics within the context of model performance or reasoning.
